			custom_tooltip = { text = tv_govhouse_mil_order_patrols_policy_effect_tt }
			hidden_effect = {
			  leader_country ?= {
			    tv_govhouse_refresh_all_governor_modifiers_effect = yes
			  }
			}
		}
	}

	# Frontier Levies
	tv_govhouse_mil_frontier_levies_policy = {
		allow = {
			always = yes
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_GOVHOUSE_POLICY_BASE_BIAS"
				value = 40
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:recipient
					scope:recipient = {
						international_organization_has_leader = yes
						has_variable = ai_io_law_target
						var:ai_io_law_target = scope:policy
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_IO_LEADER"
					value = {
						value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"
						multiply = 0.5
						min = -100
						max = 100
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "IO_LEADER_DIP_REP"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation
					multiply = 5
				}
			}
		}
		on_activate = {
			custom_tooltip = { text = tv_govhouse_mil_frontier_levies_policy_effect_tt }
			hidden_effect = {
			  leader_country ?= {
			    tv_govhouse_refresh_all_governor_modifiers_effect = yes
			  }
			}
		}
	}

# LAW 11: Local Governor Duty Tendency
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
tv_govhouse_governor_duty_tendency_law = {
	type = international_organization
	law_category = tv_govhouse_governor_functions
	potential = {
		international_organization_type = international_organization_type:tv_govhouse
	}
	allow = {
		uses_parliament_for_law_votes_trigger = yes
	}
	locked = {
	}
	requires_vote = yes
	custom_tags = { forbids_no_policy }

	# Focus Restoration (default)
	tv_govhouse_duty_restore_policy = {
		allow = {
			always = yes
		}
		wants_this_policy_bias = {
			add = {
				desc = "TV_GOVHOUSE_POLICY_BASE_BIAS"
				value = 60
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:recipient
					scope:recipient = {
						international_organization_has_leader = yes
						has_variable = ai_io_law_target
						var:ai_io_law_target = scope:policy
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_IO_LEADER"
					value = {
						value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"
						multiply = 0.5
						min = -100
						max = 100
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "IO_LEADER_DIP_REP"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.modifier:diplomatic_reputation
					multiply = 5
				}
			}
		}
